title: Tech Note: Preventing Web Page Caching with ACI Pack

historical_commentary.text: Web page caching control remains a relevant concern in web development, though the approach of using a plug-in command (ACI Pack) to inject meta-tags into HTML responses is very much a product of its time. Modern 4D handles HTTP headers directly through built-in web server commands, and cache control is now managed via standard HTTP headers rather than HTML meta-tags.
related_updates: ACI Pack plug-in has been discontinued
Modern 4D's web server provides direct HTTP header control via WEB SET HTTP HEADER and related commands
Cache control is now handled via standard HTTP Cache-Control and Expires headers rather than HTML meta-tags
